title: Thinking Long, but Short: Stable Sequential Test-Time Scaling for Large Reasoning Models
authors_zh: Michael R. Metel、Yufei Cui、Boxing Chen、Prasanna Parthasarathi（机构：华为诺亚方舟实验室）
paper_type_zh: 免训练的串行测试时扩展研究（Findings of EACL 2026）
best_for_zh: 研究长推理、推理稳定性与 KV 缓存高效扩展的读者。
one_line: Min-Seek stabilizes sequential test-time scaling by retaining only short reconstruction thoughts in a custom KV cache.
Min-Seek 通过在定制 KV 缓存中仅保留短重构思考，稳定串行测试时扩展。
why: It treats memory retention as a first-class control over whether additional reasoning steps help or destabilize a model.
inclusion_reason: It directly changes how sequential inference computation and memory are retained to prevent degradation as reasoning length grows.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Sequential test-time scaling asks a reasoning model to continue reconsidering a problem through additional reconstruction cycles. A few extra thoughts can improve an answer, but pushing the sequence further often produces repetition, unstable attention, and declining accuracy. The deployment problem is therefore not merely how to make a model think longer; it is how to prevent earlier, flawed self-revisions from overwhelming the useful context as more inference compute is spent.

The paper asks whether a training-free memory policy can stabilize this process over a much wider range of reasoning lengths. It also addresses a systems constraint: retaining every past thought makes the KV cache grow with the sequence and eventually hits the context limit. The desired procedure should preserve enough useful history for another revision while avoiding both attention degradation and the quadratic cost associated with an ever-growing cache.

串行测试时扩展要求推理模型通过额外的重构循环持续重新思考问题。少量额外思考能够改善答案，但继续拉长序列通常会产生重复、不稳定的注意力以及下降的准确率。因此，部署问题不只是怎样让模型思考更久，而是怎样在投入更多推理计算时，防止早先错误的自我修订淹没有用上下文。

论文追问：一种免训练的记忆策略能否在更宽的推理长度范围内稳定这一过程。它还处理一个系统约束：保留每一条过去思考会使 KV 缓存随序列增长，并最终触及上下文限制。理想程序应保留足够的有用历史以支持下一次修订，同时避免注意力退化和持续增长缓存带来的二次成本。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Min-Seek starts from the observation that long and unsuccessful reasoning often contains many recovery attempts, whereas sound reasoning is frequently more direct. Instead of trying to identify every semantically important earlier thought, it uses the complementary objective of removing history likely to destabilize the next revision. Its simple retention rule keeps the shortest reconstruction cycle produced so far, together with the prompt and first thought, as the compact context for subsequent thinking.

The second idea is a custom KV cache that stores keys without position embeddings and applies contiguous positions again before generating the next reconstruction cycle. This permits the retained thoughts to remain compact rather than accumulating their original positions. The combination makes additional sequential computation a controlled loop with bounded remembered state, rather than an ever-longer transcript that the model must attend to in full.

Min-Seek 从一个观察出发：冗长而失败的推理往往包含许多恢复尝试，而可靠推理通常更直接。它不试图识别每条语义上重要的早期思考，而是采用互补目标，去除可能使下一次修订失稳的历史。其简单保留规则是：与提示和第一条思考一起，保留到目前为止最短的重构循环，作为后续思考的紧凑上下文。

第二个思想是定制 KV 缓存：它不带位置嵌入地存储键值，并在生成下一次重构循环前重新施加连续位置。这样，被保留的思考可以保持紧凑，而不会累积原来的位置。二者结合后，额外串行计算成为一个具有有界记忆状态的受控循环，而非模型必须完整注意的一份持续增长的长记录。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method repeatedly induces reconstruction cycles after an initial reasoning thought. At each stage, it compares the current cycle with retained cycles by length and keeps only the shortest one in the cache, while preserving the prompt and initial thought. The design deliberately uses length as a rule for excluding potentially problematic history, not as a claim that the shortest text is always the complete or logically best solution.

For cache management, keys are retained without positional embeddings and are dynamically encoded contiguously when the next cycle is generated; values are retained as usual. Because only a fixed small subset of cycles remains in the cache, the method can continue producing thoughts beyond the ordinary maximum context length under the paper’s stated conditions. The paper evaluates this training-free procedure on reasoning tasks with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B and 7B models.

该方法在初始推理思考之后反复诱导重构循环。在每个阶段，它按长度比较当前循环与已保留循环，并只在缓存中保留最短的一条，同时保存提示和初始思考。该设计刻意将长度作为排除潜在问题历史的规则，而不是声称最短文本总是最完整或逻辑最优的解答。

在缓存管理上，键值不带位置嵌入地保留，并在生成下一次循环时动态编码为连续位置；数值则照常保留。由于缓存中只剩固定而很小的一部分循环，在论文说明的条件下，方法可以持续产生超过普通最大上下文长度的思考。论文在推理任务上用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 的十五亿和七十亿参数模型评估这一免训练程序。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official paper reports experiments over five reasoning tasks and compares Min-Seek with standard generation and Budget Forcing across a broad range of induced-thought counts. Its reported finding is that Min-Seek provides higher and more stable accuracy across those lengths, rather than requiring a narrowly tuned stopping point. The paper also argues that bounding the cached cycles permits linear computational complexity under mild conditions and makes longer sequential inference practically faster than retaining all prior thoughts.

This evidence is valuable because it measures the failure mode of sequential scaling itself: whether an added revision still helps after the apparent sweet spot. It does not mean that short reasoning is universally correct or that cache pruning preserves all information. A reviewer should inspect the task-wise curves, the number of retained cycles, memory measurements, and model-specific implementation details before applying the result to architectures with different positional encodings or reasoning formats.

官方论文报告了五项推理任务上的实验，并在广泛的诱导思考次数范围内，将 Min-Seek 与标准生成和 Budget Forcing 比较。论文报告的发现是，Min-Seek 在这些长度下提供了更高且更稳定的准确率，而不是需要一个狭窄调优的停止点。论文还认为，在温和条件下限制缓存循环可带来线性计算复杂度，并使长串行推理在实践中快于保留全部历史思考。

这些证据有价值，因为它测量的是串行扩展本身的失效模式：在表面最佳点之后，额外修订是否仍有帮助。它并不意味着短推理总是正确，也不意味着缓存裁剪保留了全部信息。审阅者在把结论应用于不同位置编码或推理格式的架构前，应检查分任务曲线、保留循环数、内存测量和模型特定的实现细节。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive contribution is to treat KV-cache retention as the control variable for sequential test-time scaling. Earlier approaches commonly force another thought and leave the full growing history available to attention. Min-Seek instead changes what the next thought can attend to, so the same additional generation budget is spent under a deliberately constrained, evolving memory state. This connects reasoning stability to a concrete systems object rather than only to a prompt or a final-answer selector.

The shortest-cycle rule is also unusual because it is an exclusion heuristic. The paper does not posit that the model should preserve the most elaborate history; it aims to keep the context least associated with error-recovery loops. Combining this rule with re-positioned cached keys lets the method pursue unbounded sequential reasoning while keeping only one additional reconstruction cycle, offering a direct response to both instability and cache growth.

其独特贡献是把 KV 缓存保留作为串行测试时扩展的控制变量。早期方法通常强迫再生成一段思考，并让注意力保留不断增长的完整历史。Min-Seek 则改变下一次思考能够注意到什么，因此同样的额外生成预算是在一种刻意受限、不断演化的记忆状态下花费的。这把推理稳定性连接到具体系统对象，而不只连接到提示或最终答案选择器。

最短循环规则也不同寻常，因为它是一条排除式启发法。论文并不认为模型应保留最复杂的历史，而是试图保留与错误恢复循环关联最少的上下文。将该规则与重新定位的缓存键结合后，方法可在只保存一条额外重构循环的同时追求无界串行推理，直接回应了不稳定性和缓存增长两个问题。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The shortest-retained-cycle rule is a heuristic whose relationship to logical correctness may vary by task, language, or model family; a concise cycle can omit a necessary correction, while a longer one can contain decisive evidence. The custom cache relies on particular key, value, and positional-encoding behavior and may need substantial engineering adaptation for other serving stacks. The reported results establish stability on the studied reasoning tasks and models, but they do not by themselves guarantee that unlimited reconstruction cycles will remain beneficial for tool use, factual generation, or open-ended planning.
保留最短循环是一条启发规则，它与逻辑正确性的关系可能随任务、语言或模型家族而变化；简短循环可能遗漏必要修正，而较长循环也可能包含决定性证据。定制缓存依赖特定的键、值和位置编码行为，在其他服务栈上可能需要大量工程适配。报告的结果证明了所研究任务和模型上的稳定性，但并不能单独保证无穷重构循环对工具使用、事实生成或开放式规划仍然有益。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Min-Seek as a systems-oriented baseline when a reasoning application already induces sequential revisions and suffers from overthinking or KV-cache pressure. Log each cycle’s length, retained state, answer change, correctness, cache size, token count, and latency; then compare full-history prompting, fixed-window retention, and shortest-cycle retention under identical generation budgets. The paper is especially helpful for distinguishing two different interventions that are often conflated: asking for more reasoning and deciding which past reasoning is allowed to influence the next step.
当推理应用已诱导串行修订，却受到过度思考或 KV 缓存压力困扰时，可把 Min-Seek 作为系统导向的基线。应记录每个循环的长度、保留状态、答案变化、正确性、缓存大小、词元数和延迟；随后在相同生成预算下比较完整历史提示、固定窗口保留与最短循环保留。论文尤其有助于区分两种常被混淆的干预：要求更多推理，以及决定允许哪些过去推理影响下一步。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The key audit question is whether the observed gain comes from shorter retained context, from positional re-encoding, or from their combination. Read the cache update procedure closely, including what is copied, which keys retain position-free versions, and how prompt information remains accessible. A rigorous reproduction should vary the retention rule while holding the cycle-generation prompt and model fixed, then report the entire accuracy-versus-induced-thought curve rather than only its peak. It should also test whether a model’s shortest cycles are genuinely less error-prone or simply more likely to terminate early.
关键审计问题是，观察到的收益来自更短的保留上下文、位置重新编码，还是二者组合。应仔细阅读缓存更新程序，包括复制了什么、哪些键保留无位置版本，以及提示信息如何持续可访问。严格复现应在固定循环生成提示和模型的前提下改变保留规则，并报告完整的准确率—诱导思考次数曲线，而不只报告峰值。它还应检验模型最短的循环是否确实更少出错，还是仅仅更容易提前结束。
